mapper.sql: id, task_id, execution_time, is_success, error_message, result_number, result_json
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitor_record(task_id, execution_time, is_success, error_message, result_number, result_json) VALUES(#{taskId}, #{executionTime}, #{isSuccess}, #{errorMessage}, #{resultNumber}, #{resultJson})
mapper.select: SELECT execution_time FROM monitor_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND is_success = 1 ORDER BY execution_time DESC LIMIT 1
